harnessCorrections: Initial prepare stopped while test flags were still false; no preparation mutation occurred before the corrected saved flags.

A separate Cyber attempt hit genuine latency admission retries; the helper incorrectly counted historical runs as live runs. It was fixed to count terminal_at IS NULL, without changing latency thresholds. Disconnected clients were safely refunded.
The final read-only audit used received_at for commercial_provider_events after the initial created_at query failed.
